# GTA6Touch

> An independent GTA 6 guide: mission walkthroughs, the Leonida map and checklists you can tick off while you play. Facts confirmed by Rockstar or two sources.

GTA6Touch is an independent, unofficial fan guide to Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). Each page states whether its information is confirmed by Rockstar Games, lists its sources and shows the date it was last updated. Content may be quoted with a link to the page.

Languages: [English](https://gta6touch.com/).

---

# GTA 6 Cheats: All 61 Cheats, Codes and How to Unlock Them

URL: https://gta6touch.com/cheats/gta-6-cheats/
Updated: 2026-11-26
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has 61 cheats in five groups; button codes are confirmed for 21 of them so far.
- Cheats unlock only after the main story (reported as 91 missions), and each cheat has its own unlock task.
- The money cheat is Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right for $250,000. Cheats switch off saving and trophies.

GTA 6 has 61 cheats, but none of them work until you finish the story. They come in five groups: player, combat, vehicle spawns, world and screen filters. Each one also has its own unlock task, such as shooting-range medals, races or collectibles. Button codes are confirmed for 21 cheats so far; the rest are listed below with their unlock tasks, and we add each code as soon as two independent sources agree on it. Rockstar has not released an official list, so this page is marked partly confirmed.
How to enter cheats in GTA 6

Finish the main story. Launch guides report 91 story missions; the Cheats section appears under the Progress tab after the credits.
Complete the unlock task for the cheat you want.
Save your game. Cheats turn saving off.
In free roam, press Up on the D-pad to open the phone.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox Series X|S. Guides differ on the wording: some say to hold L1 (LB) first and then press R1 (RB).
Enter the code on the D-pad.

All codes use only the D-pad, so they are the same on PS5 and Xbox.
Code patterns

Vehicle spawn codes start with Left, Up, Right, Down.
The three ammo cheats share the opening Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up.
The screen filter codes start with Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left.

Checked on November 20: still 18 confirmed codes
We compared seven code lists again the day after launch. The 18 codes above match on every list that includes them, and none of the lists contradicts another.

Drunk. A code for the Drunk cheat now appears on two sites, but one of them says the input comes from a single outlet's guide and is not widely corroborated. That is one source, not two, so it stays off the table until an independent guide or Rockstar confirms it.
Raise Wanted Level. Its code is on four lists. Three other guides still mark it as not found, so treat it as the least certain of the 18.
Cycle Weather. The code is agreed. The unlock task is not: guides say either finishing the story or revealing the whole map.
Everything else. No code has been published for the other 42 cheats.

Second check, later on November 20
We ran the comparison again against three more lists: GTABase, Beebom (updated November 19) and Red Bull. All three show the same 18 codes, input for input, and all three still mark the other 43 cheats as "to be announced", including Drunk. Nothing was added to or removed from the tables above.
Two details from that check:

Cycle Weather. All three lists give "finish the story" as the unlock task, which is now the more widely reported version.
Story length. The lists disagree on how many missions stand between you and the Cheats menu: Red Bull says 91, Beebom says 118. The condition itself, finishing the main story, is the same everywhere.

Beebom alone says a cheat can be switched off by entering its code again. One source is not enough, so treat that as unconfirmed.
Checked on November 21: no new codes
Two days after launch the count has not moved. GTABase's list, read again today, still shows 61 cheats with 18 codes and marks the other 43 as "to be announced". Its 18 codes are the same as ours, input for input, and so are the unlock tasks.
Beebom's list, updated on November 20 and read again in a second check today, agrees: 61 cheats, the same 18 codes, 43 still to be announced.
Two details from GTABase are worth knowing, although we have not yet seen a second guide state them:

Entering the code of a cheat you have not unlocked does nothing.
Saving stays off until you quit, so progress made after a cheat is lost when you leave; loading the earlier save restores trophies.

Third check on November 21: Drunk still unconfirmed
A later comparison the same day looked at four lists again.

GTABase and KeenGamer still give no code for Drunk. GTABase shows 18 codes; KeenGamer shows 17 and marks Raise Wanted Level as undiscovered.
GTABoom now counts 19 codes because it includes an input for Drunk. Its other 18 match ours input for input.
Dexerto shows an input for Drunk as well, but we could not read its table cleanly enough to compare every direction, and we noted earlier that the Drunk input traces back to a single outlet.

That is not two independent sources we can check against each other, so Drunk stays out of the table. No code was added, removed or changed today. Two lists also repeat the rule that saving stays off until you quit: GTABase and KeenGamer both say to save first and quit without saving to get trophies back.

Raise Wanted Level stays in the table: GamesRadar+ gives the same seven inputs we list, which agrees with the lists checked earlier. Two of today's three still mark it as undiscovered, so it remains the least certain code.
Drunk stays out. GamesRadar+ now prints an input for it, and its November 20 note says it found no other new cheats. GTABoom also showed an input yesterday, but we have not been able to compare the two sequences side by side, and the other lists still mark the cheat as undiscovered. It goes into the table when two lists we can read show the same directions.
Cycle Weather. GamesRadar+ still gives "reveal the entire map" as the unlock task; KeenGamer and Gamer Tweak say "finish the story", as most lists do.
Turning cheats off. Gamer Tweak says weather and screen-filter cheats can be switched off by entering the same code again. Beebom said something similar earlier. No list we have read shows this for the other cheat types, so save first and reload to be sure.
Patches. The update trackers at Beebom and Red Bull still list version 01.002.001 from November 16 as the latest, with no official notes. No title update since launch has added, removed or changed a cheat; see GTA 6 update.

Videotape is added: Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down. PC Gamer and Shacknews print the same ten directions, and we compared them one by one. Unlock task: complete 50 activities with your partner.
Dark Mirror is added: Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left, Right, Left. The same two lists agree on it. Unlock task: earn $500,000 selling vehicles.
Both fit the filter pattern. They open with the eight directions shared by Dollhouse, Faded Glory and Cataclysm, and their last two directions are not used by any other confirmed filter. Most lists still have no code for them, so treat both as less certain than the launch-day codes.
Drunk is now on four lists we could read with the same ten directions: PC Gamer, Shacknews, TrueAchievements and Pure Xbox.
Our other 18 codes are unchanged. Every list above that includes them matches ours, direction for direction. Two smaller sites print a different order for Raise Wanted Level or Vehicle Force; each stands alone against all the others, so we changed nothing.
No second source for the other 40 cheats. None of today's lists gives an input for No Fall Damage, Parachute, Repair Vehicle, Unlimited Nitrous, the five explosive and fire cheats, the 18 remaining vehicle spawns, the two time cheats or the other 11 filters. The full set of inputs we saw on GTABase yesterday is still the only one, and we could not open GTABase or GamesRadar+ today.
Unlock tasks. Two lists (Shacknews and Pure Xbox) give "make $250,000 from fenced goods" as the task for the $250,000 cheat, and Pure Xbox gives 100 melee takedowns for Attack Force. Every other list says both unlock when you finish the story, so the tables keep that version. Cycle Weather is still split between finishing the story and revealing the whole map.
Saving and trophies. No change. Every list that covers it says an active cheat disables saving and trophies or achievements for the rest of the session. Pure Xbox adds that saving stays off even after you switch the cheat off, which matches the advice to save first and reload.

Entry method and penalties. Unchanged on both lists: phone up, hold the two shoulder buttons, enter the code; a locked code does nothing; trophies and saving are off while a cheat is active. GTABase adds that some cheats cancel each other, giving Attack Force and Unlimited Focus as its example.
Lists we could not open today: GameSpot, GamesRadar+, PC Gamer and Game Rant.

What cheats switch off

Saving is disabled while a cheat is active.
Trophies and achievements cannot be earned in that session.
Cheats are for story mode free roam only.

Tips for unlocking cheats faster

Many unlock tasks count progress you make during the story, so play shooting ranges, races and workouts as you go.
Do challenge groups in pairs: five challenges unlock one vehicle, all of them unlock a second.
Unlock tasks that need your partner (hours together, store robberies, activities) are easiest to finish in free roam after the credits.

How we check this page

The list of 61 cheats and their unlock tasks matches across several independent launch guides.
A code is listed only when at least two independent guides show the same inputs.
The status stays "partly confirmed" until each code is entered in the released game. If a patch changes a code, we update the table and the date at the top.

Looking for the money code on its own? See GTA 6 money cheat. For police levels, see GTA 6 wanted level.

Q: Does GTA 6 have cheat codes?
A: Yes, according to early guides published the day before launch: 61 cheats, entered with the D-pad through the in-game phone. Rockstar has not published an official list.

Q: What is the GTA 6 money cheat?
A: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right gives $250,000. It is reported to unlock after you finish the main story.

Q: Can you use cheats from the start of GTA 6?
A: No. The Cheats menu is reported to appear only after the main story is finished, and many cheats need an extra task, such as shooting-range medals or workouts.

Q: How many cheats are in GTA 6?
A: 61: 10 player cheats, 11 combat cheats, 21 vehicle spawns, 3 world cheats and 16 screen filters.

Q: Do cheats disable trophies and achievements in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Reports say an active cheat disables saving and blocks trophies and achievements for that session, so save first.

# GTA 6 Mission List and Walkthrough Hub

URL: https://gta6touch.com/missions/gta-6-mission-list/
Updated: 2026-11-26
Status: live

- GTA 6 opens with the Prologue; Chapter 1 runs from Gone Fishing to Discharge Time, and the story has five chapters.
- We add each mission to this list in story order once its name, objectives and steps are verified.
- Every walkthrough covers objectives, a step-by-step route, common fail points and optional goals.

This page is the home of our GTA 6 mission list. Rockstar Games has not published a list of missions, so we add missions here in story order as each one is verified in at least two independent walkthroughs. The first 93 are listed below, each with a walkthrough.
How the mission list works

Story order. Missions are listed in the order the story unlocks them, grouped by the character or contact who gives them.
One page per mission. Each mission gets its own walkthrough, linked from this list.
Verified first. A mission appears only when its name, objectives and steps have been checked against the game.

What each walkthrough includes

Before you start: where the mission begins, which protagonist you play, and anything worth buying first.
Objectives: the on-screen goals in order.
Step-by-step route: what to do at each stage, with the safest approach.
Where players fail: the usual causes of a mission failure and how to avoid them.
Optional goals and rewards: bonus objectives and what the mission unlocks.

What is confirmed about the story

You play as two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
The story is set across the state of Leonida; see the GTA 6 map guide.
Rockstar describes the launch game as a single-player experience; see GTA 6 online.

Mission list
The story is split into a Prologue and numbered chapters. The missions below are the ones whose names and order match in at least two independent walkthroughs. Later missions are added as they are verified; guides note that some missions can appear in a slightly different order depending on what you do first.

Both PowerPyx and VGC end Chapter 1 with Discharge Time. The two guides swap a few neighbours (Lab Fees and Just a Scratch, Buck Me and Clean Up After Donnie, Day Release and Clear Skies), and several early missions can be played in any order, so the numbers are a guide to the order rather than a fixed count. PowerPyx also lists optional and missable tasks between these missions; we cover the ones before Lucia's release in the Coming Home walkthrough. Between Clear Skies and Swamped, PowerPyx counts a short scene at the house, Building a Life, as its own mission; VGC folds it into Clear Skies.
Point of no return: Tourist Trap, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time play back to back, and free roam does not return until Chapter 2. Read the checklist in the Recalibration walkthrough before you start Tourist Trap.
Chapter 2 and later
PowerPyx divides the story into five chapters. Chapter 2 opens in a motel in Kelly County with Lucia as the playable lead.

The rows from Lawyer Up onward are in PowerPyx's order. GTABase places Eddie Acosta's party before Company Cars and Party Hard before Heavy Lifting; both of those missions only need Lawyer Up, so either order works. PowerPyx also lists a short entry, Pay Abe's Fee, after Party Hard, which GTABase does not have.
Missable: Bad Driver! disappears once you start Power Play. Plan ahead: after Making Gainz, Jason and Lucia cannot be seen together in public until the VCIA Takedown, so do It's a Date! and other couple activities first.
The rows from Too Much Baggage to Power Play are in PowerPyx's order, and each mission's requirements match on GTABase. Too Much Baggage, Watch It and Adventures in Babysitting only need Making Gainz, so the game can offer them earlier. PowerPyx also counts several short entries that GTABase folds into the missions around them or does not list: Blood Sweat and Gear, Call Nate, Nate Will Be in Touch, Rafa's Kidnapping and the optional, missable This is a Free Call From…
The rows from Close Surveillance to Starting From Zero are in PowerPyx's order. Close Surveillance, Delivery Method, Team Building and Fully Catered all open after Power Play and can be done in any order; GTABase lists Headliners before them, but both guides require it before the heist. PowerPyx also counts two waiting entries that GTABase does not list, Heist Plans in Place and Call Valentina Back; they are explained in the Fully Catered and Tie Up Loose Ends walkthroughs.
Point of no return: collecting the note at the Y Hotel starts Sunset, and both guides say that moves the story into Chapter 5. PowerPyx adds that most of Chapter 5 must be finished before free roam returns. Do That's Where the Money Is… and any side activities first.

More help

Q: How many missions are in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not announced a mission count. Launch guides report 91 main story missions; we will confirm the number once the full story has been verified.

Q: Are the walkthroughs spoiler-free?
A: Mission titles and steps are unavoidable in a walkthrough, but we keep story twists out of titles, summaries and the list on this page.

Q: Can you replay missions in GTA 6?
A: No. PowerPyx, Beebom and Insider Gaming all report that GTA 6 has no mission replay and no mission medals. Rockstar has not commented, so keep a manual save before any mission you may want to play again.

# GTA 6 Cars: Full Vehicle List and How to Keep a Car

URL: https://gta6touch.com/vehicles/gta-6-cars/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has hundreds of vehicles under fictional brands; launch guides have named well over 100 cars so far, from the Ganado pickup to the Zorrusso supercar.
- You cannot just keep a stolen car: from Chapter 2 you register it at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, and later at Pay 'n' Spray.
- Unregistered cars disappear when you leave them, so register the cars you want and keep a garage slot free.

GTA 6 cars number in the hundreds, all under fictional brands, and launch guides have already named well over 100 of them. This page lists every car that at least two launch guides name, sorted by class, then covers bikes, boats and aircraft, the vehicles tied to the editions, and the part most players get wrong: a stolen car is not yours until you register it. Rockstar has not published an official vehicle list, so names come from guides that agree with each other, and the page stays marked partly confirmed.
Facts here are confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides.

Sports cars
Banshee (Bravado), Coquette and Coquette D10 (Invetero), Comet S2 Cabrio and Comet Retro Custom (Pfister), Growler (Pfister), Neon (Pfister), Jugular (Ocelot), 8F Drafter (Obey), Omnis e-GT (Obey), Vectre (Emperor), Cypher (Übermacht), Sultan (Karin), Futo (Karin), Penumbra (Maibatsu), Sugoi (Dinka), Blista Compact (Dinka), Paragon R (Enus), Schafter V12 (Benefactor) and Carbonizzare (Grotti).
Why it matters: sports cars balance speed and grip, which makes them the safest choice for timed missions and police chases.
Muscle cars
Dominator, Dominator ASP, Dominator GT and Dominator GTX (Vapid), Gauntlet Classic and Gauntlet Hellfire (Bravado), Buffalo and Buffalo STX (Bravado), Ruiner and Phoenix (Imponte), Vigero ZX Convertible, Sabre Turbo, Tulip, Tulip M-100 and Vamos (Declasse), Buccaneer and Buccaneer Custom (Albany), Chino and Slamvan (Vapid) and the Impaler SZ (Declasse).
Tip: the red Imponte Phoenix appears in the Hamlet impound in an early mission, and Moses pays for a souped-up Vamos in his optional car-theft jobs.
Sedans, coupes and everyday cars
Asterope GZ and Intruder (Karin), Primo and Primo Custom (Albany), PMP 700 (Schyster), Stratum (Zirconium), Emperor, Stanier (Vapid), Tailgater (Obey) and the Sentinel Classic (Übermacht).

More on pickups and semis is in GTA 6 trucks.
Why it matters: Jason's Vapid Ganado is the only car you have in Chapter 1, and pickups and off-roaders handle the swamp roads of Grassrivers far better than sports cars.
Classics and edition vehicles
Classic cars named by launch guides include the Cheetah and Cheetah Classic (Grotti), the '55 Stanier (Vapid), the Gauntlet Classic (Bravado), the Deviant (Schyster), the Sirius (Declasse) and the Sentinel Classic (Übermacht).
Rockstar's own edition descriptions name seven vehicles, and both GTAside and Overgear list the same seven:

See GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for what the upgrade adds.
How to steal, register and keep a car
Stealing a car does not make it yours. Guides agree that an unregistered car disappears once you leave it, die or quit, so registration is the real way to build a garage.

Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Registration unlocks in the Moses walkthrough, which also gives Lucia the Slim Jim for quiet break-ins, the Scooter Bros app that delivers your car, and a free registered vehicle.
Scan before you steal. Use the WAiNK phone app to check a car's tracker. Moses only takes cars with no tracker, and he refuses cars stolen right next to his garage.
Respray and register. Drive into Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, pick a new colour, then choose Register instead of Sell.
Keep a slot free. You start with one garage slot, so register a car you will actually drive. More space comes with new properties as the story goes on.
Use Pay 'n' Spray later. After Welcome to Vice City, Moses texts that Pay 'n' Spray shops can buy and register cars with standard trackers. Cars with advanced trackers need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3.

Tip: a registered car used in a crime and left inside the police search area can be impounded. The Scooter Bros app returns it for a fee; the Impounded Vehicle walkthrough covers it.
Selling stolen cars
The cars you do not keep are income. Moses buys untracked cars from Chapter 2, Pay 'n' Spray buys cars with standard trackers later, and Randy buys high-end cars from Chapter 3. Cars in good condition sell for more. Payouts are in how to make money in GTA 6.
What is not confirmed yet

Top speeds. Rockstar has not published any, and the "fastest car" lists from before launch are estimates. We will rank cars only with tested numbers.
The exact number of vehicles. Guides count differently, from about 300 to more than 500 depending on whether variants count.
Customisation menus for every car.

What we will add to this page

A tested top-speed ranking by class
Where each car spawns, starting with the supercars
Customisation shops and their prices

Q: What cars are in GTA 6?
A: Launch guides list sports cars such as the Banshee, Coquette D10 and Itali GTO, supercars such as the Zorrusso, Tempesta, Emerus and Thrax, muscle cars such as the Dominator and Gauntlet, and SUVs, pickups and classics. The full list by class is on this page.

Q: How do you keep a car in GTA 6?
A: Register it. From the Chapter 2 mission Moses, take a car without a tracker to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it and choose Register. Unregistered cars vanish once you leave them.

Q: Can you buy cars in GTA 6?
A: Launch guides describe stealing and registering cars rather than a dealership. Your first registration with Moses is free, and some vehicles come from missions, editions or cheats.

Q: Are there real car brands in GTA 6?
A: No. Vehicles use fictional brands such as Pegassi, Grotti, Vapid and Declasse, with designs that resemble real cars.

# GTA 6 Map: All Confirmed Regions of Leonida

URL: https://gta6touch.com/map/gta-6-map/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 is set in the fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida.
- Six regions are officially named: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- Rockstar has not published an official map image or a map size.

GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a fictional state modelled on Florida. Rockstar's official site names six regions. Here is what each one is.
Interactive GTA 6 map
Click a region (or pick it from the list) to see what it is and jump to our guides for that part of Leonida.

Where each region is

Mount Kalaga National Park runs along the northern border of the state.
Port Gellhorn sits on the west coast.
Ambrosia is inland, next to Lake Leonida.
Grassrivers covers the swampy south-west.
Vice City is on the south-east coast.
Leonida Keys stretch south of Vice City.

These positions are what Rockstar's descriptions and several mapping guides agree on. Exact borders and distances will only be clear once a full in-game map is documented, so our map above is a schematic, not a to-scale copy.
Confirmed GTA 6 locations

Region
What it is

Vice City
The main city: beaches, nightlife and neon, inspired by Miami

Leonida Keys
A chain of tropical islands off the mainland, inspired by the Florida Keys

Grassrivers
Swamp and wetland wilderness, inspired by the Everglades

Port Gellhorn
A run-down coastal town on Leonida's forgotten coast

Ambrosia
An industrial heartland town built around a sugar refinery

Mount Kalaga National Park
Forested hills and backcountry in the north of the state

Vice City
Vice City returns for the first time since 2002's GTA: Vice City, now as a modern city. Expect the dense urban centre of the map here, along with the beach districts shown in the trailers.
Leonida Keys
The Keys are where Jason Duval is based at the start of the story, working for local drug runners.
Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga
These regions make up the rest of the state: wetlands, a faded coastal town, an industrial town and a national park. They give the map its countryside, in the way Blaine County did for GTA 5.
What is not confirmed

Map size. No official figure exists.
A full map image. Maps shared online before launch are fan-made from trailers and screenshots.
Interiors and exact landmarks. We will document these on separate pages once verified in the game.

We will add location guides for collectibles, shops and activities to this section after release.

Q: Where does GTA 6 take place?
A: GTA 6 takes place in the fictional US state of Leonida, which includes Vice City and the surrounding regions. It is inspired by Florida.

Q: What cities are in GTA 6?
A: Vice City is the main city. Rockstar has also named the towns and areas of Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia, plus the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga National Park.

Q: How big is the GTA 6 map?
A: Rockstar has not given an official size. Comparisons with GTA 5 that you see online are fan estimates.

Q: Is there an official GTA 6 map?
A: Rockstar has described the regions on its website but has not released a full official map image before launch.

# GTA 6 100% Completion: Full Checklist and Reward

URL: https://gta6touch.com/missions/gta-6-100-completion/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- The 100% checklist has 35 requirements in three groups: Story & Tasks, Exploration & Activities, and Discovery.
- Many requirements are lower than the full total, for example 300 of 397 stunts and 100 of 255 animals.
- Nothing is missable, and the reward is the gold trophy A Long Road (100G on Xbox).

GTA 6 100 completion means finishing the story and 34 other requirements on an in-game checklist. The checklist has 35 lines in three groups. Most lines ask for less than the full total, so you can skip the stunts, races or collectibles you like least. The game only shows the checklist after the story ends.
What counts for 100% in GTA 6
Only the 35 lines below count. The "Needed" column is the target. The "Total" column is how many exist in the game, where guides give it.

See GTA 6 cars and GTA 6 animals for what to look for.
What you must do in full
Eleven lines have no slack. You need every one of these:

39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs and 8 Vaults.
33 Underwater Discoveries.
42 Shooting Range gold medals and 42 Drone Time Trials.
2 Unique Playlists, 4 Video Games and 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
The main story.

Everything else leaves room. You can skip 97 stunts, 10 challenges, 10 races, 77 base model vehicles and 155 animals.
Can you miss anything?
No. Two guides state that nothing is missable for 100% and that every line can be finished in free roam after the story. A few things to know:

Some Optional Tasks can be missed during story missions. It does not matter, because there are enough others to reach 100.
Kenton is not available for a while after Chapter 1. He returns later.
The video games on the TV cannot be played during part of Chapter 2.
Bret's hunting tasks are for Jason only.
A Gang Operation that you did not clear fully comes back, but it takes a long time.

GTA 6 100% checklist reward
The reward is A Long Road, a gold trophy on PS5 and a 100G achievement on Xbox. It is the largest achievement in the game and is needed for the platinum. Guides do not agree on any other reward, so we do not list one.
The checklist also covers most other trophies on the way. It asks for 300 stunts where the stunt trophy needs 250, and 70 challenges where the challenge trophy needs 50. One exception: the meditation trophy needs all 18 spots, while the checklist needs 15. The full list is in our GTA 6 trophy guide.
A sensible order

Play the story and do optional tasks, robberies and stranger missions as you meet them.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start. These two lines take the longest.
After the credits, open the checklist and see what is left.
Finish the full-count lines first, then pick the easiest of the rest.

Q: What do you need for GTA 6 100 completion?
A: Finish the story and meet 34 other requirements: robberies, fenced goods, collectibles, races, shooting ranges, stunts, challenges, and scanning vehicles, weapons and animals.

Q: What counts for 100% in GTA 6?
A: Only the 35 lines on the in-game checklist. Most have a target below the full total, so you do not need every collectible, every stunt or every animal.

Q: What is the reward for 100% in GTA 6?
A: The gold trophy A Long Road, worth 100G on Xbox. It is also needed for the platinum.

Q: Can you miss anything for 100% in GTA 6?
A: No. Guides agree that every requirement can be finished in free roam after the story.

# GTA 6 Collectibles: Every Type, How Many, and What They Unlock

URL: https://gta6touch.com/map/gta-6-collectibles/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has 18 collectible card sets with 480 cards, 125 cocaine flamingos and 34 luxury watches, plus WAiNK scans, underwater discoveries and meditation spots.
- You do not need everything for 100%: for example 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 flamingos and 100 WAiNK scans are enough.
- Several collectibles unlock cheats, including the Inflatable Flamingo and the two time-of-day cheats from watches.

GTA 6 collectibles come in more than a dozen types, led by 480 collectible cards, 125 cocaine flamingos and 34 luxury watches. This hub lists every type, how many there are, what each one unlocks and where to check your progress. It does not list individual locations. Counts are given only where at least two launch guides agree; those guides are still being filled in, so this page is marked partly confirmed.

The Progress menu also counts things you discover rather than pick up: 277 base model vehicles, 255 animals and a weapons list. For 100% you need 200 vehicles and 100 animals. See GTA 6 cars and GTA 6 animals.
GTA 6 collectible cards
There are 18 sets and 480 cards. Sets have between 12 and 36 cards each.

What to know:

Cards lie around the world, indoors and outdoors. Outdoors they are often in yellow boxes.
Colour variants of a card count as separate cards for the set.
You can sell cards at pawn shops. A sold card still counts toward its set.
3 complete sets earn the Don't Touch My Deck trophy. 15 complete sets are needed for 100%.
All 24 Vice City Flamingos cards are the reported unlock task for the Bubblegum screen filter cheat.

GTA 6 cocaine flamingos
Cocaine flamingos are pink flamingo figures with a drug package inside. There are 125. You destroy them; you do not pick them up.

The ones that count have a black and white beak. Ordinary lawn flamingos do not count.
50 destroyed is the reported unlock task for the Inflatable Flamingo spawn cheat.
100 destroyed counts toward 100% completion. No trophy is tied to them.

GTA 6 watches and other styles
The Styles category has 79 entries: magazine styles for Jason, magazine styles for Lucia, magazine tattoos and 34 luxury watches. You need 70 of the 79 for 100%.
Watches matter for cheats. Finding 10 collectible watches is the reported unlock task for Move Time Forward, and 20 for Pause Time of Day.
WAiNK scans
WAiNK is the phone scan app. Guides agree on 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures. No Flusher tags, which are spray-paint markings on the ground, also count, but guides do not agree on how many there are. 100 scans earn the You WAiNKer! trophy and tick the 100% requirement.
One cheat, the Powdered Sugar filter, is reported to need all space debris scanned with WAiNK. Launch guides have not yet listed how many pieces there are.

Cheats only work after the story, and codes for most of these are not published yet. The full list is on GTA 6 cheats.
Where to see your progress
Open the menu (Touch Pad on PS5) and go to Progress.

Progress &gt; Collections holds collectible cards, WAiNK locations, styles and an Exploration group with underwater discoveries, magazines, meditations and flamingos.
Some sub-categories only show up after you find the first item of that type.
Progress &gt; Stats &gt; 100% Completion shows the full checklist. It appears only after you finish the story.

Tips

Do not chase full sets of everything. The 100% checklist leaves spare items in most categories.
Sell duplicate and finished cards at pawn shops. It costs you no progress and feeds the Pixel Art unlock.
Check the beak before you spend ammo on a flamingo.
Collectibles pair well with GTA 6 challenges: several exploration challenges are about cards, scans and underwater finds.

Q: How many collectibles are in GTA 6?
A: There is no single official number. The main collectible types that launch guides agree on are 480 collectible cards in 18 sets, 125 cocaine flamingos, 79 styles (34 of them luxury watches), 33 underwater discoveries, 18 meditation spots and at least 89 WAiNK scan locations.

Q: Do you need all GTA 6 collectibles for 100% completion?
A: No. The 100% checklist asks for part of most types: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 100 WAiNK locations, 70 of 79 styles and 15 of 18 meditation spots. All 33 underwater discoveries are needed.

Q: What do cocaine flamingos unlock in GTA 6?
A: Destroying 50 cocaine flamingos is the reported unlock task for the Inflatable Flamingo spawn cheat. Destroying 100 of the 125 counts toward 100% completion.

Q: Can you sell collectible cards in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Cards can be sold at pawn shops, and guides agree that a sold card still counts toward its set.

# GTA 6 Gone Fishing Walkthrough: Mission 2 Step by Step

URL: https://gta6touch.com/missions/gta-6-gone-fishing-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Gone Fishing is the second mission and the first one you play as Jason.
- It teaches boats, binoculars, stealth takedowns, fist fights, healing and flying.
- An optional stash of cash in a trailer can be missed during the escape.

This GTA 6 Gone Fishing walkthrough covers the second mission of the game, the first one you play as Jason. It starts right after the Prologue and is a long tutorial: a boat, binoculars, stealth, a fist fight, a shootout and a seaplane.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Gone Fishing (mission 2, Chapter 1)

Playable character
Jason

Mission giver
Cal

Starts
On a boat with Cal, straight after the Prologue

Requirement
Finish the Prologue

Missable
Cash in a trailer during the escape

Next mission
Gear Up

There is nothing to prepare. The mission starts automatically and gives you everything you need.
Objectives
Guides word these slightly differently. The order is the same:

Follow the plane and collect the packages.
Watch the deal in the swamp.
Search the camp for Donnie.
Find a way into the shack and untie Donnie.
Head to the plane.
Fly back to Brian's Marina.

Step-by-step
1. Follow the plane and collect the packages
Jason and Cal wait on a boat. Donnie, the pilot, flies over and drops packages into the sea. Drive the boat after the plane. The packages are marked on the map. Slow down next to each one, or Cal cannot hook it out of the water.
2. Watch the deal
After the last package, follow the route on the minimap into the swamps. When the game asks, take out the binoculars: open the weapon wheel with L1/LB and pick them from the bottom-right slot. Watch the meeting on the docks. It goes wrong, and the Kingfishers gang takes Donnie.
3. Search the camp for Donnie
Bring the boat to the docks near the camp. Jason goes in alone.

Crouch with Circle/B.
Come up behind a guard and grab him with R2/RT.
Press Square/X to knock him out.
Work your way to the far end of the camp. Donnie is held in a shack there.

VGC suggests using the tall grass on the right side of the camp for cover. Going in loud is possible, but you have only one weapon at this point, so stealth is the easier way.
4. Get into the shack and untie Donnie
Wait for the guard near the shack to move, then go in through the front door and untie Donnie. A large Kingfisher walks in and you have to fight him with your fists. Press Square/X to hit. The X/A button is your defence: PowerPyx calls it a block, VGC calls it a dodge.
He drops Zombix, the game's healing item. Pick it up, then equip a gun.
5. Head to the plane
The camp is now alert, and you fight your way to the dock. You do not have to beat every enemy. Reaching the plane is enough.
On the way there is a trailer with cash inside. Getting it is optional. VGC warns that an enemy jumps out when you go in, so be ready.
6. Fly back to Brian's Marina
Get in the seaplane and fly to the marker. Land on the water and bring the plane in to the marina. A cutscene introduces Brian, Jason's boss.
The guides that cover the ending (VGC and GTABase) agree that Jason then goes back to his house in the Keys and gets a phone call from Lucia. VGC adds that you drop Cal at his home first. That call ends the mission.
Where players fail

Going too fast past the packages. Cal needs the boat almost stopped beside each one.
Standing up in the camp. Stay crouched and always approach guards from behind.
Skipping the Zombix. Pick it up after the fist fight. You will want the healing during the run to the plane.
Fighting everyone on the dock. The goal is the plane, not a clean sweep.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Trailer cash
Optional and missable. In a trailer near the route to the plane. Guides do not give the amount.

Unlock
PowerPyx lists Jason's house in Key Lento as the reward. GTABase shows one unlock without naming it.

Medals
None. PowerPyx reports that GTA 6 has no mission medals and no mission replay.

PowerPyx and GTABase also describe a reputation system that starts here: quiet takedowns and non-lethal play push Jason one way, and killing pushes him another. We will cover it in a separate guide once the details are tested.
Next up is the Gear Up walkthrough. For the whole story in order, see the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Gone Fishing walkthrough for the stealth part?
A: Yes. Crouch with Circle/B, come up behind each guard, grab with R2/RT and press Square/X to knock them out. Work towards the shack at the far end of the camp.

Q: Which mission comes after the Prologue in GTA 6?
A: Gone Fishing. It is the second mission overall and the first mission of Chapter 1.

Q: Can you miss anything in Gone Fishing?
A: Yes, one thing. During the escape there is cash in a trailer near the route to the plane. It is optional and guides mark it as missable.

Q: What comes after Gone Fishing?
A: Gear Up, where Jason buys a long gun at Ammu-Nation.

# GTA 6 Prologue Walkthrough: The First Mission Step by Step

URL: https://gta6touch.com/missions/gta-6-prologue-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Prologue is the first mission in GTA 6 and you play it as Lucia.
- It starts at Hamlet Correctional and teaches talking, aiming and running on foot.
- There is no reward and nothing to miss; the next mission is Gone Fishing.

This GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough covers the first mission of the game from the opening cell to the final cutscene. Prologue is short and works as a tutorial. You play as Lucia, and the mission leads straight into Gone Fishing.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Prologue (GTA 6 first mission)

Playable character
Lucia

Starts at
Hamlet Correctional, in Lucia's cell

Requirement
None, it begins when you start a new game

Reward
None

Next mission
Gone Fishing

You cannot prepare for this mission. There is no free roam before it, and no choice here changes the story.
Objectives
The exact wording differs a little between guides, but the order is the same:

Talk to your cellmates.
Go with the prison guard.
Threaten the teller and grab the cash.
Lose the cops.
Return to the coffee shop.

Step-by-step
1. Talk to your cellmates
Lucia starts at the window of her cell. Turn around and face one of the cellmates. Hold L2/LT to focus on a person, then use the prompt to speak. This is the game's first lesson in how talking to people works, and you will use it for the whole story.
2. Go with the prison guard
After a short wait, a guard, CO Wilson, opens the cell and walks Lucia through the block. He stops in the common area for a phone call, then carries on. Follow him down the corridor to the counselor's office. You can look at other inmates on the way, but the mission only moves on when you reach the office.
The counselor's questions start a flashback to the crime that put Lucia in prison.
3. Rob the payday loan store
You take control again inside a payday loan store.

Hold L2/LT to aim at the teller.
Press Square/X to threaten him. He starts handing over cash.
Pick up the money from the counter.
A customer grabs Lucia from behind. Press the button shown on screen to shake him off.

4. Lose the cops
Police arrive as Lucia leaves, and you have to run. Jump and climb over obstacles with X/A. The flashing blue and red area on the minimap is the zone the police are searching. For how that system works in the open world, see GTA 6 wanted level.
Guides do not agree on this section:

Source
What it says about the chase

PowerPyx, GTABase
You cannot escape. The game cuts back to the counselor's office by itself.

VGC
You can be caught, which ends the mission in cutscenes, or you can get away on foot or in a vehicle, which leads to the coffee shop section.

In practice this does not matter for progress. Both versions end the mission the same way, and none of the guides lists a fail state here.
5. Return to the coffee shop
When the chase is over, follow the marker on the minimap back to the coffee shop. Lucia is arrested as she gets close. This is scripted and cannot be avoided. A cutscene explains why she went back, and the Prologue ends.
Where players fail

Trying too hard to win the chase. The arrest is part of the story. If the police catch you or the scene cuts away, nothing has gone wrong.
Missing the talk prompt. You have to hold L2/LT on a cellmate first. Walking up to them is not enough.
Not picking up the money. The teller puts the cash on the counter. The robbery does not move on until you take it.

Optional goals and rewards
Guides list no optional goals and no reward for the Prologue. PowerPyx also reports that GTA 6 has no mission medals and no mission replay, so there is nothing to come back for.
After the final cutscene the story moves to Chapter 1 and to Jason. Continue with the Gone Fishing walkthrough, or see the full GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What is the first mission in GTA 6?
A: The first mission in GTA 6 is called Prologue. You play as Lucia, starting in a cell at Hamlet Correctional. It is followed by Gone Fishing, the first Chapter 1 mission.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough for the chase?
A: Yes. Run from the store, climb over obstacles and keep moving. Guides differ on whether the chase can be won, but every guide agrees the mission ends the same way, so you cannot fail the story here.

Q: Who do you play as in the GTA 6 Prologue?
A: Lucia. Jason becomes playable in the second mission, Gone Fishing.

Q: Does the Prologue give a reward?
A: No. Guides list no reward for the Prologue. It is a tutorial that sets up the story.

# Vice City in GTA 6: Districts and What to Expect

URL: https://gta6touch.com/map/gta-6-vice-city/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Vice City is the largest city in GTA 6 and is modelled on Miami.
- It returns for the first time since GTA: Vice City in 2002, now set in the present day.
- Ocean Beach is confirmed by name through the pre-order bonus garage.

Vice City is the heart of GTA 6. It is the biggest city in the state of Leonida and Rockstar's modern take on Miami: beaches, high-rises, nightlife and money.
What is confirmed

It is the main urban area of the map, with the densest streets and crowds.
It is set today, with phones, social media and modern cars. The 1980s version belongs to the 2002 game.
Ocean Beach exists by name. The pre-order bonus garage, Shore Court, is described as being near Ocean Beach.
Local businesses matter to the story. Boobie Ike, a Vice City figure, has interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs the label Only Raw Records. See GTA 6 characters.

Vice City and the rest of Leonida
Vice City is one of six named regions. The others are the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. The full overview is in our GTA 6 map guide.
Things to do in the city
Official footage shows gyms, shops you can rob, beach activities and street life. Radio matters here too: Vice City FM is among the reported stations. See GTA 6 radio stations.
Coming to this page
A district-by-district guide with safehouses, shops, garages and collectibles, added as each is verified in the game.

Q: Is Vice City in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Vice City is the main city of the state of Leonida, where GTA 6 takes place.

Q: What city is GTA 6 based on?
A: Vice City is modelled on Miami, and the wider state of Leonida on Florida.

Q: Is GTA 6 set in the 1980s?
A: No. It is set in the present day. The 1980s setting belonged to 2002's GTA: Vice City.

# GTA 6 Wanted Level Explained: Six Stars and Heat

URL: https://gta6touch.com/missions/gta-6-wanted-level/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has six wanted stars, one more than GTA 5.
- Red heat icons under the stars show what police know: your face, your clothes, your vehicle.
- Changing what the police can recognise is as important as getting out of sight.

GTA 6 uses a six-star wanted level with a new heat layer on top. Stars show how hard the police respond. Heat shows what they know about you. This page is based on Rockstar's Extended Look and hands-on previews, and we will add tested details from the released game.
Stars: how hard the police come
The meter runs from one to six stars. GTA 5 capped it at five, so the top end is higher. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia reach four stars in a chase, with police cars and a helicopter already involved. Rockstar has not listed which crimes give which star level.
Heat: what the police know
Under the stars sits a row of red icons. Each one is a piece of information the police have:

Icon
What police know
How to clear it

Face
What you look like
Wear a mask during crimes, or change your look

Clothes
What you are wearing
Change into a different outfit unseen

Vehicle
What you are driving
Switch to another vehicle

Companion
Who you are with
Split up or stay out of sight

Witnesses who call the police and security cameras are how this information gets collected.
Hot areas
After you escape, the place where police were searching stays marked for a while. Coming back too soon, while they can still recognise you, can restart the chase. Previews report that at six stars the search covers the whole map.
How to lose the cops

Break line of sight.
Get out of the search area.
Change what they can identify: car first, then clothes.
Stay away from the hot area until it cools.

Wanted level cheats
Two reported cheat codes raise heat and the wanted level. Both unlock after escaping 3-star chases; see GTA 6 cheats.

Q: How many wanted stars are in GTA 6?
A: Six. GTA 5 stopped at five; the sixth star was last used in a main game in GTA 4.

Q: What is heat in GTA 6?
A: Heat is the information police hold about you, shown as red icons under the stars: your face, your outfit, your vehicle and who you are with.

Q: How do you lose the police in GTA 6?
A: Break line of sight, leave the search area and change what they can identify: swap vehicles, change clothes or cover your face.

---

# How to Make Money in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter

URL: https://gta6touch.com/cheats/how-to-make-money-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Selling stolen cars to Moses from Chapter 2 is the first steady income, at about $1,000 or a little more per ordinary car.
- Jewelry store robberies from Chapter 3 pay roughly $10,000 to $20,000 or more each.
- Bank vaults open up late in Chapter 4, pay six figures and bring a 4-star wanted level.

The way to make money in GTA 6 changes with each chapter: sell stolen cars from Chapter 2, rob jewelry stores from Chapter 3 and hit bank vaults late in Chapter 4. This page lists only legitimate in-game methods that at least two launch guides agree on. Where guides give different payouts, we say so. We will add our own tested numbers later.
GTA 6 money methods compared

Method

Disables saving

First, protect what you earn
Cash in your pocket is lost when you are wasted or busted. Three guides agree on this.
The fix is a bank account. It opens during the Chapter 1 story mission "Buck Me", which also puts the BuckMe app on your phone. After that, use the app's ATM Finder and deposit your cash at the nearest ATM before you try anything risky.
Early game: hold-ups, races and activities
At the start you have few options, and none of them pay much.

Store hold-ups. Aim your weapon at the clerk and take the cash from the register. Stores, restaurants and gas stations all work. Expect a wanted level; see how the wanted level works.
Races. Race events are spread across the map and pay cash for a win.
Gang operations. These combat-heavy locations reward cash and valuables.
Story missions. They pay a little, and they unlock every better method below.

No two guides give matching payouts for these, so we do not list numbers.
Chapter 2: sell stolen cars to Moses
Moses is the first real source of income in GTA 6. He appears early in Chapter 2, gives you a slim jim for breaking into cars and buys what you bring him.

Steal an ordinary, older car. Moses does not take cars fitted with trackers.
Keep it in good shape. Damage lowers the price.
Drive it to his auto shop and sell it.
Wait a short while. He will not buy another car straight away.

PowerPyx, PC Gamer and Beebom all put a regular car at about $1,000 or a little more. It is not a fortune, but each run takes only a few minutes.
Two more activities are worth knowing in this part of the game. The Demolition Derby at Ambrosia Raceway pays out for a win, and Bret pays for animals you hunt. Guides agree that both exist, but only one gives figures.
Chapter 3: jewelry stores and better cars
Chapter 3 is where the money starts to grow.
Jewelry store robberies
Jobs for Yasmani introduce jewelry store robberies, which the game calls Smash 'n' Grabs. Beebom reports $10,000 to $20,000 per store depending on what you take. PowerPyx reports $10,000 to $25,000. Either way, one store is worth more than ten cars sold to Moses.
Yasmani's work also leads to the snap gun, a tool that opens locked doors without setting off the alarm. Use it to reach back rooms and safes.
Randy and Pay 'n' Spray
Randy is a car fence who arrives in Chapter 3 and wants expensive, high-end cars. He pays far more than Moses, but guides do not agree on the amount: PC Gamer puts car sales at up to $20,000 depending on model and fence, while PowerPyx reports $30,000 or more for a car in perfect condition.
Pay 'n' Spray locations also buy vehicles. GamesRadar says they become available in Chapter 1, while PowerPyx lists selling tracked cars there as a Chapter 3 option, so treat the timing as unconfirmed. For the cars themselves, see our GTA 6 cars guide.
Chapter 4 and after: bank vaults
Bank vault robberies are the top earner. They unlock late in Chapter 4. The method is to follow a security van to a bank and get into the vault while it is open.

Payout: Gamers Heroes reports about $100,000 per bank. PowerPyx reports $100,000 to about $200,000.
Risk: an instant 4-star wanted level, according to PowerPyx and Beebom.

Plan your escape before you go in. A fast vehicle and a second one to switch to make a big difference.
Smaller extras

ATMs. With a winch fitted to your vehicle at a Mod Shop, you can pull out an ATM. It is loud and draws police.
The map index. The Robberies section of the map index lists targets such as Smash 'n' Grab locations, Payday Loan stores and banks, so you can plan a route.

The $250,000 money cheat
GTA 6 has a money cheat that adds $250,000, but it is reported to unlock only after the main story is finished, and an active cheat turns saving off. It cannot help you during the story. The code and steps are in our GTA 6 money cheat post, and every other reported code is on the GTA 6 cheats page.

Q: What is the best way to make money in GTA 6?
A: Late in the story it is bank vault robberies, which guides put at $100,000 or more per job. Before that, jewelry stores in Chapter 3 and car sales to Moses in Chapter 2 are the most reliable.

Q: How to make money in GTA 6 at the start?
A: Hold up store clerks, enter races and play the story until Chapter 2, when Moses starts buying stolen cars. Bank your cash at an ATM, because cash you carry is lost when you are wasted or busted.

Q: Can you make money fast in GTA 6 with a cheat?
A: Only after the story. The reported $250,000 cheat unlocks once the main story is finished, and using it switches off saving.

Q: Where do you sell cars in GTA 6?
A: At Moses' auto shop from Chapter 2, at Pay 'n' Spray locations, and to Randy from Chapter 3 for high-end cars. Cars in good condition sell for more.

# Port Gellhorn in GTA 6: Location Guide

URL: https://gta6touch.com/map/port-gellhorn-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Port Gellhorn is one of the six regions of Leonida named by Rockstar.
- It is a run-down coastal town away from Vice City.
- A race circuit with the Gellhorn name appears in gameplay footage and cheat unlocks.

Port Gellhorn is a faded coastal town in GTA 6, one of six regions Rockstar names on its official site. It sits on what the site calls Leonida's forgotten coast, far in mood from the neon of Vice City.
What Rockstar has shown

A town of cheap motels, closed attractions and strip malls.
A working-class, down-on-its-luck feel compared with the tourist coast.

Racing at Gellhorn
Official gameplay footage shows wheel-to-wheel racing on a purpose-built circuit. Reported cheat unlocks name Gellhorn Raceway as one of three race venues where you need ten first-place finishes to unlock the Repair Vehicle cheat, alongside Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway. See GTA 6 cheats.

Q: Is there a race track in Port Gellhorn?

- Rockstar has not officially announced the voice cast.

Rockstar has introduced the main cast of GTA 6 on its official site. Here is everyone confirmed so far.

A Vice City local legend turned businessman, with interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio

Dre'Quan Priest
A music hustler and Boobie's partner in the label Only Raw Records

Real Dimez
Rap duo Bae-Luxe and Roxy, signed to Only Raw Records

Raul Bautista
A veteran bank robber who is always looking for talent for the next score

Brian Heder
An old-school drug runner in the Keys who lets Jason live rent-free in return for help

How the two protagonists work
Rockstar has confirmed that you play as both Jason and Lucia. Exactly how and when you switch between them is something we will document from the game after launch, on the mission list and in each walkthrough.
Voice actors
Rockstar traditionally does not announce the cast before release, and it has not done so for GTA 6. We will add the cast from the game's credits.

Q: Who is the main character in GTA 6?
A: There are two main characters: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Both are playable.

Q: Is Lucia the first female protagonist in GTA?
A: Lucia is the first female lead protagonist in a mainline 3D Grand Theft Auto game.

Q: Who are the GTA 6 voice actors?
A: Rockstar has not officially announced the voice cast. Names circulating online are unconfirmed until Rockstar or the credits confirm them.

Q: Are Michael, Franklin or Trevor in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not confirmed any returning GTA 5 protagonists.

# Jason Duval in GTA 6: Everything Confirmed

URL: https://gta6touch.com/characters/gta-6-jason-duval/
Updated: 2026-11-18
Status: confirmed

- Jason Duval is one of GTA 6's two playable protagonists.
- He grew up around grifters, joined the Army to escape that life, and now works for drug runners in the Leonida Keys.
- He lives rent-free on a property owned by Brian Heder in exchange for helping with shakedowns.

Jason Duval is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6. He was introduced in the first trailer and is the focus of the second.
Jason's backstory
According to Rockstar's official character description:

He grew up around grifters and crooks.
He joined the Army to get away from that life.
After his service he ended up in the Leonida Keys, doing what he knows best: working for local drug runners.
He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder.

Where Jason lives and who he works with

Brian Heder, a veteran drug runner, lets Jason live rent-free at one of his properties in the Keys as long as Jason helps with local shakedowns.
Cal Hampton is Jason's friend: a homebody with a taste for conspiracy theories.

See the full cast on the GTA 6 characters page.
Jason and Lucia
Jason is in a relationship with Lucia Caminos. Rockstar suggests that meeting her could be the best or the worst thing that ever happened to him. The story follows the pair after a simple score goes wrong.
Playing as Jason
You play as both Jason and Lucia. We will cover his missions and any character-specific abilities in the missions section after launch.

Q: Who is Jason in GTA 6?
A: Jason Duval is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6, alongside his partner Lucia Caminos.

Q: Was Jason in the military?
A: Yes. Rockstar's description says he spent time in the Army trying to shake off a troubled youth.

Q: Who plays Jason in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not officially announced Jason's actor. Treat names online as unconfirmed.

# Lucia Caminos in GTA 6: Everything Confirmed

URL: https://gta6touch.com/characters/gta-6-lucia-caminos/
Updated: 2026-11-18
Status: confirmed

- Lucia Caminos is one of GTA 6's two playable protagonists.
- She grew up in Liberty City, learned to fight from her father and has just been released from Leonida Penitentiary.
- Her goal is the good life her mother dreamed of, and she is planning it with Jason.

Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6, and the first female lead in a mainline 3D Grand Theft Auto game.
Lucia's backstory
According to Rockstar's official character description:

Her father taught her to fight from a young age.
She grew up in Liberty City and has had to fight for her family.
That fight landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; the first trailer opens with her there.
She got out through "sheer luck" and has decided to make smarter moves from now on.

Lucia and Jason
Lucia is in a relationship with Jason Duval. The second trailer shows Jason picking her up on her release. Rockstar frames the story around the two of them: a simple score goes wrong, and they find themselves on the wrong side of a criminal conspiracy across Leonida, forced to rely on each other.
What Lucia wants
Rockstar describes her as more committed than ever to the good life her mother has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Rather than daydreaming, Lucia is ready to take control.
Playing as Lucia
You play as both Lucia and Jason. We will document her missions, abilities and any differences from Jason after launch in the missions section.

Q: Who is Lucia in GTA 6?
A: Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6, alongside her partner Jason Duval.

Q: Why was Lucia in prison?
A: Rockstar's description says she was fighting for her family and ended up in Leonida Penitentiary. The full story is told in the game.

Q: Who plays Lucia in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not officially announced Lucia's actor. Treat names online as unconfirmed.
